findings.evidence: The proof uses only that the first bracket with the root vector is a scalar multiple of that same root vector, after which `lie_self` makes the second bracket zero; Mathlib provides this general Cartan action as `LieAlgebra.IsKilling.lie_eq_smul_of_mem_rootSpace` (`Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Killing.lean:381`).
findings.fix: Prove the theorem for `(h : F4.cartanSubalgebra valid_F4)` using `lie_eq_smul_of_mem_rootSpace`, then derive the coroot statement as a specialization if its name is needed downstream.
findings.issue: `f4_dividedAd_sq_coroot_eq_zero` is unnecessarily restricted to elements of the form `coroot β`; the second adjoint power annihilates every element of `F4.cartanSubalgebra valid_F4`.

summary: One divided-adjoint theorem is stated only for coroots although the proof naturally applies to every Cartan element.
